files.content:
# Examples/iMessage tapback

An iMessage tapback bubble: love, like, dislike, laugh, emphasize, question.

Install emoji-picker-react 5 or later, import app.css and picker.css, then render <Shell className="imessage-picker" />. For CSS Modules, import picker.module.css and pass styles.picker as className. The component includes its app context; adapt its insertion callback to your product.
